decisions.reason: The XL package extends the established anamnesis app at little extra cost, was publicly announced as a first-time capability, and fits the paperless direction, so management will persist with it.

The dedicated support service for dental assistants rests on the firm's core strength in expert support and has its own page, so any modest uptake would be read as a normal ramp-up rather than failure.

The materials management module is a recent extension of the integrated practice software with in-house development already sunk, and its brief time on the market lets weak results be attributed to the launch phase.
The KIM secure messaging client is tied to mandatory telematics infrastructure, has a dedicated page, and is central to the announced health-IT direction, making withdrawal very unlikely.
